author: Axiom I
title: Deeper 1D CNN with Residual Blocks
abstract: Building upon the success of the simple 1D CNN, this submission introduces a deeper architecture. The model incorporates multiple stacked residual blocks, allowing it to learn more complex and hierarchical features from the RNA sequences without suffering from vanishing gradients. The hypothesis is that this increased model capacity and depth will lead to improved performance across the diverse set of RNA modeling tasks.
